description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring the status of a HorizontalPodAutoscaler in Kubernetes, including methods for building and setting its fields.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatusApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatus, with pointer fields for optional values.

methods.name: WithObservedGeneration
methods.description: Sets the observed generation in the configuration.

methods.name: WithLastScaleTime
methods.description: Sets the last scale time in the configuration.

methods.name: WithCurrentReplicas
methods.description: Sets the current number of replicas.

methods.name: WithDesiredReplicas
methods.description: Sets the desired number of replicas.

methods.name: WithCurrentCPUUtilizationPercentage
methods.description: Sets the current CPU utilization percentage.
